newsitem.title: USA: Phillips Petroleum sets repurchase plan.
newsitem.headline: Phillips Petroleum sets repurchase plan.

text.p: Phillips Petroleum Co said Monday it authorized the expenditure of up to $150 million to periodically buy back shares of the company's common stock.
Company shares were up 1/4 at 38-1/8 in late morning trading Monday.
The repurchase of shares would enable the company to meet obligations that require it to provide common stock under certain incentive compensation plans, the company said.
Phillips' outstanding shares increased an average of 600,000 per year from 1994 through 1996, the company said.
Repurchased shares will be held as treasury shares, available for general corporate purposes, the company said.
